item.title: octant/backend reward engine (octant_rewards, projects/rewards, constants)

findings.finding: Default epoch parameters: operational cost 25%, community fund 5%, total rewards 70% of ETH staking proceeds, individual rewards equilibrium 35%, matched rewards 35%.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: OPERATIONAL_COST = Decimal("0.25")  COMMUNITY_FUND = Decimal("0.05")  TR_PERCENT = Decimal("0.7")  IRE_PERCENT = Decimal("0.35")  MATCHED_REWARDS_PERCENT = Decimal("0.35")

findings.finding: Matched rewards shrink as more GLM is locked: if the locked ratio is below IRE the pool is 35% of staking proceeds; between IRE and TR it is (TR minus locked ratio) times proceeds; above TR only patron money matches. Locking beyond the equilibrium therefore lowers the public-goods match.
